implementation: Byte-identical validated scene packets plus unchanged simulation/presenter text snapshots over per-session, same-UID Linux abstract Unix sockets. Worker-thread API delivery; bounded receive/pending buffers. Scene backpressure preserves atlas order; latest complete control state coalesces; presenter heartbeat remains3s. Older viewers retain file compatibility; established IPC never reads stale files. No new interpolation, geometry, source precision, native upload budget or production-data changes. Full scene parse/staging remains; persistent mesh reuse is not implemented.

Home autostart OFF; existing runtime preserved. Native timing is application/submission evidence, not through-lens comfort. Short sequential trials, no randomized control.

Initial check invocation passed two positional targets to test-focused; rejected before execution. Corrected to sequential focused invocations.
First native build failed because view_tools.hpp is included within main.cpp's anonymous namespace. Moved transport header to top-level includes. First benchmark failed launch (no timed playback), then corrected build succeeded.
Scene-only IPC removed direct file stalls (transfers <=1.305ms), but VDW throughput still failed (78 endpoints) and gaps persisted.
A private-process sitecustomize diagnostic timed synchronous write/replace without changing repository behavior. Simulation/share control file replacements reached ~160–230ms during playback.
Expanded IPC to the two control channels; preserve text format/parser and presenter 3s liveness heartbeat. Simulation/presenter state coalesces to latest; scene packets backpressure so an atlas cannot be discarded before a referencing packet.
First complete run passes all styles (144/144/143 endpoints); all scene and control packets use IPC. Largest scene gaps 102/101/268ms versus baseline458/469/983ms. No coordinate reads or new interpolation.

Final trans-syn-II attempt failed before playback: stale job-selection control version was acknowledged but rejected safely. Harness now retries read-only selection only while no job is selected, mirroring existing trajectory-mode retry. Throughput thresholds unchanged; isolated repeat retained separately.
